categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Injoinic Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and sales of high-performance, high-quality mixed-signal integrated circuits, primarily in power management chips and fast charging protocol chips. Its products serve diverse fields including consumer electronics, smart wearables, photovoltaic new energy, lithium battery energy storage, IoT, communication equipment, and automotive electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced mixed-signal SoC integration technology, fast charging interface protocol integration, low-power multi-power management, high-precision ADC and coulomb counting, and high-power boost/buck technologies. It operates under a fabless model, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and service providers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading consumer electronics brands such as Xiaomi, OPPO, Vivo, Samsung, and Honor. The company targets markets in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, AIoT, new energy, smart audio processing, and smart home devices, with products integrated into mobile power supplies, fast charging adapters, wireless chargers, TWS earphones, and automotive charging devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with significant sales concentrated domestically, and has expanded overseas markets. It has subsidiaries and operations in major Chinese cities including Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Suzhou, Chengdu, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Xi'an, and also international subsidiaries in Singapore and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Injoinic operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless chip design company. It designs and sells integrated circuits while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries and service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in power management and fast charging technologies, focusing on automotive-grade chips, new energy chips, PMU chips, AI power management, and smart audio amplifiers. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 21% of revenue allocated to research, and maintains a strong patent portfolio. Future plans include expanding into low-power IoT, automotive electronics, AIoT, and smart home markets, while enhancing talent acquisition and industry collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of integrated circuits, including power management chips and fast charging protocol chips. The company uses a mixed sales model combining distribution channels and direct sales to end customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Injoinic is positioned as one of the leading domestic suppliers of power management and fast charging protocol chips in China. It competes with other semiconductor design firms in the analog and mixed-signal IC sector, leveraging its technology advantages and strong customer relationships with major consumer electronics brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.43 billion, a 17.66% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 124 million, a 323% increase. The company has shown strong growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding product lines and market penetration. Total assets reached RMB 2.13 billion with net assets of RMB 1.99 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Injoinic offers highly integrated, customizable, and cost-effective mixed-signal SoC chips that shorten customer product development cycles and improve reliability and yield. Its fast charging protocol chips are recognized for high reliability and broad compatibility with multiple fast charging standards, securing authorization from major platform providers. The company’s geographic proximity to key customers in the Pearl River Delta enhances responsiveness and service quality.
